def accepted(cap: int, xs: list[int]) -> int uses nondet:
    """Create a channel of ints with capacity cap and try to send each element of xs without blocking. Return how many sends were accepted before the channel was full, stopping at the first refused send."""
    pre cap >= 0
    post out >= 0
    post out <= cap
    post out <= xs.len()
    ch: Channel[int] = Channel.new(cap)
    n = 0
    for x in xs:
        if not ch.try_send(x):
            break
        n += 1
    return n
